main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess 10-bar forward return on forecast (forecast > 0, non-overlapping grid)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and mean excess > 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean excess 10-bar return of forecast > 0 grid cases

decided_by: The slope's t lies between -2 and 2.
reading: The coin's mean 10-bar return is the mean over all grid cells of all its windows, the slope is an OLS fit with intercept, and the plan's 'fewer than 100 cases' rule is treated as a minimum count giving 'not observable'.
